acceptance_checks.evidence: Selection was locked on train/dev; one access event preceded the unique test-only artifact.
Effect size, bootstrap CI, AUROC, balanced accuracy, pairwise accuracy and structure-preserving permutation are retained.
All frozen nulls, controls and probes were run; the unrelated control is template-dominated and the control plan was post-target-metrics.
Seven test pairs form only two independent family clusters; the exact permutation p-value is 0.5.
No activation intervention or behavioral steering experiment was performed in Phase 2.

decision_basis: Phase completion is measured against the authorized Phase 2 pilot scope, not against a desired positive finding.
The held-out directional results are consistent across the target, orthogonalized direction and linear probes.
Bootstrap uncertainty cannot replace the low-resolution family-cluster permutation result.
The post-target-metrics control timing prevents describing the gate as confirmatory preregistration.
Representation evidence does not authorize a causal steering claim.

recommended_next_step.minimum_target: Use the existing plan target of at least 40 held-out test families, with power and family allocation frozen before model access.
recommended_next_step.forbidden_shortcut: Do not reuse the opened seven-pair test for selection, tuning, new hypotheses or Phase 3 method ranking.

claim_boundary: Phase 2 is complete as an auditable exploratory single-axis representation pilot. It does not pass the gate for confirmatory causal steering, personality control, cross-axis inference or cross-model generalization.
